title: OPC 40001-1 - Machinery Basic Building Blocks
catalogCoverage: complete: sections 1-20 and annexes A-C all read

rules.summary: A MachineryItem supporting AddIns has a MachineryBuildingBlocks folder
Each AddIn is referenced both directly and from MachineryBuildingBlocks
Every machine is referenced directly from the Machines Object via Organizes
Manufacturer and SerialNumber are present on MachineryItemIdentification
MonthOfConstruction only appears alongside YearOfConstruction
ProductInstanceUri is present and read-only on a machine
YearOfConstruction is a four-digit number
A component carries a mandatory Identification AddIn
Server support for minimum string lengths and locale counts
The building blocks Table 12 marks mandatory are referenced
Common Attributes are set as Tables 7-9 specify
Language-neutral LocalizedText carries no locale
Every Object under Machines provides the MachineIdentificationType AddIn
The Machines Object is organized under the Objects folder
A MachineryLifetimeCounter holds at least one lifetime variable
A Status Object references the state and operation-mode AddIns it has
ProductInstanceUri is at most 255 characters
Operation counters only increase and never reset
An unavailable read-only optional Node is not provided
Several References lead to one Node rather than duplicating it
Machine vendors do not repurpose ComponentName for their own identification
Clients reach the Machines Object by its standardized NodeId
Methods defined by this specification are executable
Clients do not infer manufacturer uniqueness from ProductInstanceUri
Nameplate Properties are used as their Interface defines them
